notes: Checked: main header nav, footer nav, homepage flight-data links, and the site's own category sitemap (4841 URLs from sitemap-cat.xml) for clearance/outlet-language URLs. Found a genuine, permanently-merchandised clearance hub: 'Destockage et offres speciales > Destockage massif' (https://www.castorama.fr/destockage-et-offres-speciales/destockage-massif/cat_id_5021.cat), a real PLP (verified product tiles + 'totalResults' JSON field + rendered '2 164 produits' header) with a site-exposed category facet panel showing 12 genuine department children (each fetched directly and its own results header read; leaf counts sum to ~2167 vs parent 2164, the small variance being normal live-inventory drift between fetches, not a mismatch in structure). Sale-vs-Clearance test: qualifies as genuine Clearance, not a temporary promo - the page's own products carry a 'Destockage' badge and the on-page disclaimer 'Offre destockage valable dans la limite des stocks selon magasin' (offer valid while stocks last per store), a permanence/outlet signal, not a dated campaign. Distinguished this from the separate 'Bonnes affaires' (deals) hub's other children (offre-du-moment, offres-de-remboursement, foire-a-la-droguerie, les-journees-du-bricolage, selection-* curated pages, idees-cadeaux) - those are temporary promotional/curated marketing pages with no clearance/outlet permanence signal and were excluded as Sale, not Clearance, per brief section 3. No other clearance-labelled ('Fin de serie', 'Outlet', 'Derniere chance') hub found on the site.
